correctness.rationale: The geodesic angle at a sampled longitude between adjacent half-gaps a,b is ψ_c(a)+ψ_c(b), with ψ_c(a)=atan2(cos a,c sin a); independent 3D tangent-dot calculations confirmed 16 nongeneric test angles. The ordered half-gap simplex density and monotone ψ reduce the maximal angle to two shortest gaps and yield the stated exact one-dimensional integral. Both contributing ψ values decrease strictly in c, with a switching boundary of positive area, establishing strict probability monotonicity. Near equator c↓0 the event forces a=O(c), b−π/2=O(c), three disjoint bounded rescaled charts; their indicator densities converge L1 to the planar triangle D of area 2/3, producing p(c)~4c²/π² and conditional marked total variation convergence. The polar c↑1 limit is the planar cyclic-triangle 2/3 probability. Finite tests are corroborative, not an infinity proof.
